notes.title: ★ Keys ★
notes.notes: We've checked the keys to the game and closed the keys which were given to make videos or reviews or tweets but the materials haven't been made. If your key stopped working groundlessly, you can contact us to get a new key. Please write straightaway in the email where you have received the key and the link to the advertising material about the game.

notes.title: Third Person Controller
notes.notes:
Now you can play with a 3d person view.
You can change camera view in options during the battle.

notes.title: New Armor Set
notes.notes:
A new armor set helping save fuel while operating a tank and other machinery is added.
Congrats to our most active gamer of October and November - demonmars80 - who gets it as a gift!
Other players may find its parts on the battlefield.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30516345/873bcb344c0b778b1edc0a330f27a3a8c72d8308.gif[/img]
